title: Crop Insurance Schedule of Planting Dates, Prevented Planting and Replant Figures by Crop
content:
Crop Insurance sets final planting dates, prevented-planting payment shares and replant payments crop by crop, together with the late-planting terms of each plan and coverage level.

## By crop (the same at every plan and coverage level)

| Crop | Final planting date | Prevented-planting payment (% of the guarantee) | Replant payment (bushels per acre replanted) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Corn | May 25 | 55.0% | 8.0 |
| Soybeans | June 10 | 60.0% | 3.0 |
| Grain sorghum | June 25 | 60.0% | 5.0 |
| Winter wheat | October 15 | 60.0% | 3.0 |

These crop figures apply unchanged to Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT), Revenue Protection 65% Coverage, Revenue Protection 70% Coverage, Revenue Protection 75% Coverage, Revenue Protection 80% Coverage and Revenue Protection 85% Coverage.

## By plan and coverage level

| Plan and coverage level | Late planting period | Guarantee reduction per day planted late | Replant threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | 0 days (no late-planting coverage) | 0.0% | 20% |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | 25 days | 1.0% | 20% |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | 25 days | 1.0% | 20% |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | 25 days | 1.0% | 20% |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | 25 days | 1.0% | 20% |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | 25 days | 1.0% | 20% |

## Definitions

- **Final planting date** — Month-day of the final planting date by crop.
- **Late planting period** — Days after the final planting date during which planting keeps reduced coverage; a figure of 0 means no late-planting coverage.
- **Guarantee reduction per day** — Guarantee reduction per day planted after the final planting date, %.
- **Prevented-planting payment** — Prevented-planting payment as % of the guarantee, by crop.
- **Replant payment** — Replant payment in bushels per acre replanted, by crop, valued at the projected price.
- **Replant threshold** — Replant payments apply when at least this % of the unit (or 20 acres) must be replanted.

## Worked readings (hypothetical inputs)

- *Corn planted 10 days after May 25 under Revenue Protection 75% Coverage.* The planting falls within the 25-day late planting period, so coverage is kept at a reduced level: 10 days at 1.0% per day reduce the guarantee by 10%.
- *Corn planted after May 25 under Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT).* The late planting period is 0 days, which means no late-planting coverage.
- *Replanting soybeans.* The replant payment is 3.0 bushels for each acre replanted, valued at the projected price; at an illustrative projected price of $10.00 that is $30.00 per acre replanted.
- *Replant threshold.* With a threshold of 20%, a unit on which 20% of the acreage must be replanted reaches the threshold; so does one on which 20 acres must be replanted.
